title: Sting puts his career against Jarrett’s title
summary: Sting’s campaign against Jeff Jarrett’s control of TNA survives betrayal and repeated interference. He finally stakes his career on one championship match.

chapters.title: Christian betrays Sting
chapters.result: Jarrett retains against Sting after Christian Cage turns on Sting.
chapters.context: What appears to be support from a fellow challenger becomes another obstacle, forcing Sting to pursue a higher-stakes rematch.

chapters.title: Sting wins with his career at stake
chapters.result: Sting makes Jarrett submit to win the NWA world championship.
chapters.context: With Kurt Angle enforcing order, Sting overcomes Jarrett in the title-versus-career main event. The retirement threat is a match stipulation.
